items.name: DOP Art Fair 2027
items.shortDescription:
Join us for the 2027 Downtown Overland Park Art Fair, a two-day celebration of art, creativity and community in the heart of Downtown Overland Park, Kansas!

Enjoy live entertainment, food and the vibrant atmosphere of Downtown Overland Park while browsing original artwork and handcrafted pieces from talented local and regional artists.

Friday, June 11 | 4:00–9:00 PM
Saturday, June 12 | 8:00 AM–4:00 PM

The Art Fair will extend along Santa Fe Drive from the Thompson Park area north to 79th Street and along 80th Street from Marty Street to Conser Street.

items.name: Mulvane Art Fair 2027
items.shortDescription: The 33rd annual Mulvane Art Fair will feature artists from across the country for a two-day event that is a favorite of the community and artists alike. Be a part of this exciting event and submit your application today!

items.name: Park City Kimball Arts Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
The 58th annual Kimball Arts Festival is a three-day, award-winning visual arts festival located in the heart of the world-famous resort community of Park City, UT. Every year professional artists are selected by a blind jury to showcase their work, and more than 25,000 art enthusiasts from around the world converge on Park City’s historic Main Street to purchase it. In 2026, reported artist sales totaled over $2 million!

The Park City Kimball Arts Festival consistently ranks among the top festivals in the country for artist sales and attendee experience. Showcasing 13 visual arts media, this annual event also features live music, gourmet food and drink, and a host of creative and collaborative activities. Proceeds from the event support the Kimball Art Center, Park City's nonprofit community art center since 1976.

Accolades from Past Participating Artists:
  • “(KAF) provides us with the opportunity to be successful as artists. The show is extremely well organized and extremely profitable... It is a record show every year. Not to mention we have a blast at the show.”
  • “It's a great show and our communications with the powers that be were stellar. The quality of the show is top notch.”
  • “Fantastic audience and sales! Everyone appreciates the high quality available.”
  • “Well run, well attended, attentive staff, great sales.”
  • “I thank you for running a terrific show. Artist friendly and very well-run show.”
  • “This is our most profitable and enjoyable show every year!”

items.name: February Art Festival in the Kayenta Art Village 2027
items.shortDescription:
WELCOME TO THE FEBRUARY ART FESTIVAL 2027!

Stroll through a gathering of eclectic artists who specialize in media ranging from sculpture to painting, jewelry to ceramics, wood to metal and more. And then unwind to live music, and culinary delights from festival vendors and Kayenta’s own Xetava Gardens Café and the Rusted Cactus, all amidst stunning desert vistas.

items.name: Boston Mills Artfest 2027
items.shortDescription:
The 53rd Annual Boston Mills Artfest is a nationally recognized, juried celebration of Fine Art and Contemporary Craft, attracting talented artists, collectors, and art enthusiasts from across Northeast Ohio and beyond. Hosted at the beautiful Boston Mills Ski Resort, a Vail Resort in Peninsula, Ohio, the festival is set against the stunning backdrop of Cuyahoga Valley National Park, conveniently located between Cleveland, Akron, and Canton.

Artfest features two exceptional summer weekends, each showcasing up to 150 talented artists creating an outstanding opportunities to sell original work, connect with collectors, and reach new audiences. A $45.00 nonrefundable application fee is required

Boston Mills I (AKA “The June Show”) opens with a special Friday Night Preview Party from 6:00–9:00 p.m., followed by a two-day weekend filled with art, music, wine, craft beer, and enthusiastic shoppers.

Boston Mills II (AKA “The July Show”) kicks off the July 4th weekend with an exciting three-day show, beginning Friday from 1:00–8:00 p.m. The extended weekend gives artists an additional day of selling and exposure, while visitors enjoy a lively summer atmosphere with art, music, wine, and craft beer into the evening.

For more than five decades, Boston Mills Artfest has remained one of Northeast Ohio’s premier summer art events, offering artists a distinctive opportunity to showcase their work and become part of the celebrated tradition.

items.name: Ellis Square Art Market | Savannah, GA April 16-18, 2027
items.shortDescription:
Ellis Square Art Market – Savannah, Georgia

Experience the charm, creativity, and artistic spirit of Savannah at the Ellis Square Art Market, located in the heart of Savannah's Historic District, just steps from the vibrant City Market.

This open-air art market brings together talented local, regional, and national artists showcasing an exceptional selection of original, handcrafted works. Visitors can explore an inspiring collection of fine art, paintings, photography, sculpture, pottery, jewelry, mixed media, textiles, and other unique creations, all presented by the artists who create them.

Surrounded by Savannah's historic architecture, charming shops, restaurants, and lively streets, Ellis Square provides the perfect setting to discover one-of-a-kind treasures while meeting the artists and learning about their creative processes.

Whether you're a Savannah resident or visiting this beautiful coastal city, the Ellis Square Art Market offers a wonderful opportunity to experience art in an inviting, walkable outdoor setting.

Free and open to the public, this family-friendly event celebrates artistic expression, supports independent artists, and adds to the rich cultural traditions that make Savannah one of America's most beloved destinations.

Come stroll, explore, shop, and discover something extraordinary at the Ellis Square Art Market!


Festival Hours: Friday: 10 PM - 9 PM, Saturday: 10AM - 6 PM, Sunday: 10AM - 4PM

items.name: The Loop Music & Art Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
The Loop Music & Art Festival is a curated fine art festival in Downtown Dothan, Alabama. Now in its 6th year, the Loop is organized by public art non-profit Art in Public Places at Porter Park Plaza, Dothan's newly renovated park and amphitheater, set against the backdrop of the city's celebrated downtown murals, restaurants, and shopping. The Loop draws about 5,000 festival-goers across two days of live music and original art.

When: Friday, April 9, 2027, 4–8 PM | Saturday, April 10, 2027, 11 AM–7 PM.

The Festival is intentionally small and deliberately excellent; the Loop features 50–65 carefully curated exhibiting, demonstrating, and group artists. We believe in quality over quantity and never oversaturate the festival market. Your work gets the attention and collectors it deserves.

Built to be worth your time:

  • $3,500 in awards: Best of Show ($1,000), 2 Awards of Distinction ($575 each), 6 Merit Awards ($225 each)
  • Flat booth fee of $150 — no commission split
  • Private artist hospitality with meals, drinks, and snacks on both days
  • Booth sitters throughout the Festival
  • Loop Loot Patron Program — patrons arrive with pre-purchased dollars spent exclusively on your art + patron awards
  • Multi-channel promotion: print, radio, TV, digital ads, and social media

Free admission brings thousands of engaged, art-buying visitors. Our patrons don't browse; they come ready to collect.

Small but mighty. Curated with intention. Worth every mile.

items.name: Tulip Time Spring Makers Market 2027
items.shortDescription:
Join us for one of Michigan's premier Makers Markets at Holland's renowned Tulip Time Festival! This beloved festival, celebrating its 97th year, is a ten-day experience like none other with over six million tulips blooming throughout the city and area attractions. Tulip Time has been heralded as the nation’s Best Flower Festival and America’s Best Small Town Festival. We expect over 15,000 visitors at the Makers Market alone. 

We invite you to apply for a spot at the 2027 Makers Market, showcasing over 200 talented vendors. This juried market welcomes Artisans, Makers, Crafters, and Vintage vendors. Food Trucks and Concessions are also encouraged to apply through this application.

Don't miss this opportunity to be part of a vibrant celebration of creativity and community!

items.name: Morning Glory Art Fair 2027
items.shortDescription:
Join us for the 52nd Morning Glory Art Fair on the beautiful grounds of the Marcus Performing Arts Center in downtown Milwaukee. This location is in the heart of the downtown arts-centered environment, across the street from Saint Kate’s Art Hotel, near the downtown theater district, adjacent to the Milwaukee Riverwalk and Red Arrow Park.

Show Dates - May 22 - 23, 2027

This year will feature a refined booth layout to improve traffic flow. Artist booths will be located on a combination of flat grass or concrete. Artists will enjoy a Friday set-up, free parking, indoor restrooms, and booth sitters. Artists must dolly a short distance from the street to their booth location. Vehicles are not allowed on the grounds of The Marcus Center.

items.name: Palm Springs Art Festival - March 20 - 21, 2027
items.shortDescription:
The Palm Springs Art Festival will return on March 20 - 21, 2027,  for its 37th year at Frances Stevens Park in Uptown Palm Springs, California.

We invite you to submit your application for this popular event held in the heart of Palm Springs during the peak Season.

Artwork included in the event is 2 and 3-dimensional mixed media, ceramics, digital, glass, jewelry, metal, paintings, photography, sculpture, and wood..

items.name: Las Olas Art Fair Part I - 39th Annual (Ft. Lauderdale) January 2027 Howard Alan Events
items.shortDescription:
This year celebrates the 39th edition of the famous artistic event, the Las Olas Art Fair Part I. A cherished tradition in South Florida, the Las Olas Art Fair is regarded as one of the top events in the United States. Located in the heart of Fort Lauderdale, Las Olas Boulevard is known as the city's crown jewel.

The show is closed to the jewelry category. All jewelry applications will be juried for wait list only.

items.name: New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival presented by Shell - Contemporary Crafts 2027
items.shortDescription:
The New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival presented by Shell is a joyous and spirited celebration showcasing the authentic music and heritage of Louisiana and New Orleans. It began in 1970 when 350 musicians entertained a crowd half that number in New Orleans’ Congo Square. The Festival is one of the most prestigious and well-attended in the nation, attracting hundreds of thousands of people annually.

The Festival is owned by The New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival and Foundation, Inc., a Louisiana non-profit corporation organized to preserve and promote the music, arts, culture and heritage, indigenous to Louisiana and the New Orleans area. A two-weekend event featuring fourteen stages of music, plus art and traditional food, this outdoor daytime celebration is held on the park-like infield and in the grandstand area of the historic Fair Grounds Race Course. The Craft Fairs present works by Louisiana, national, and international artisans participating in three tented areas – Contemporary Crafts, Louisiana Marketplace, and Congo Square African Marketplace.

The highly competitive juried Contemporary Crafts Fair, located in Heritage Square, set amid some of our most dynamic musical tents, will feature approximately sixty different artists each weekend. Artists exhibit and sell fine art and fine crafts including one-of-a-kind and/or limited edition works.

items.name: Art in the Village 2027 - North Shore Art League
items.shortDescription:
The North Shore Art League is excited for our 15th annual juried fine art fair on June 12 & 13, 2027. It will take place in Hubbard Woods Park. Winnetka is a charming upscale Chicagoland destination, highly sought after zip code, located along the shores of Lake Michigan. This boutique show offers great visibility, enthusiastic buyers, and free parking.
Art in the Village is located in the community where the League began over 102 years ago!  As a beloved community asset, the League has been an instrumental force in the creative arts throughout the Chicagoland area. This show will be well promoted through Chicago media, local publications and radio stations. The park setting makes it ideal for exhibiting your works.
 
Enter this popular show! A few artist's comments:

"The show is exemplary of how a show should be run - attention to important details without making things unnecessarily complicated. Thank you for all your efforts. It is a true pleasure to be included in this show."

"Thanks for a great show Linda and team. Keep up with curating a group of well crafted artwork and quality artists and makers to keep the show top of mind for the community. This is how the event sets it self apart from other similar events in the area. Looking forward to next year!"

items.name: Artfest2027
items.shortDescription:
June 4-6, 2027, Artfest is proudly presented by the Northwest Museum of Arts and Culture (MAC.) 
Our goal is to  provide a beautiful community gathering place where fine artists come together to showcase their work to art-lovers from throughout the PNW. Located on the museum's campus in the historic Browne's Addition neighborhood of Spokane, this 3 day open-air art festival provides visitors with plenty of beautiful shade, full museum exhibition access, fun food trucks, locally crafted beer and wine, live music and entertainment, and fun hands-on activities for kids of all ages. 

ArtFest is committed to supporting artists in our region and beyond. As such, we do not take a commission; all sales go directly to you. We provide 24 hour security, booth-sitting, free admission to the museum, and an artists' dinner the night of set-up.

Our artists rave about the support they receive: 
"Appropriate number of booths, great location, attracts the people we hope to see. I noticed a chirping noise of happy people that I associate with a successful event.  Also pleased with booth spot and layout."

"We appreciate the staff and volunteers who work so diligently to make ArtFest a joyous occasion."

"Best show of the year, without a doubt the most significant location to have this event. The museum grounds are the perfect spot for a fine juried arts festival."

Thank you to our Lead Sponsor, Amazon!

items.name: Kalamazoo Institute of Arts Fair 2027
items.shortDescription:
The annual Kalamazoo Institute of Arts Fair is a two-day juried fine art show featuring up to 145 artists. Staged in shady, historic Bronson Park in downtown Kalamazoo, this outdoor Arts Fair is acclaimed for its friendly atmosphere and large crowds of arts patrons from across Michigan and beyond. The KIA Arts Fair offers many artist amenities, $4,500+ in awards and prizes, and is supported by far-reaching promotional measures attracting crowds of 14,000+. The KIA Arts Fair also features live music, food trucks, family activities and artist demonstrations to draw-in visitors and buyers.

Application and Notification: 

  • Application deadline:  January 31, 2027
  • Notification: February 12, 2027 via email
  • Accept Invitation/ Purchase Deadline: March 12, 2027

2027 KIA Arts Fair: 

  • Friday, June 4, 2027 3pm-8pm
  • Saturday, June 5, 2027  9am-5pm

items.name: Ann Arbor Summer Art Fair 2027- 58th Annual
items.shortDescription:
58th Annual Ann Arbor Summer Art Fair
July 15-17, 2027
Produced by The Guild of Artists & Artisans
Ann Arbor, MI

A celebrated art fair. An engaged audience. A community that values artists.
Bring Your Art to Ann Arbor.

For nearly six decades, the Ann Arbor Summer Art Fair has brought exceptional artists and art lovers together in one of the country’s most vibrant art destinations. Now in its 58th year, the fair offers artists the opportunity to showcase their work before a large, enthusiastic audience in the heart of downtown Ann Arbor and alongside the University of Michigan campus.

Produced by The Guild of Artists & Artisans, a nonprofit organization founded by artists in 1973, the Summer Art Fair is one of three official partner fairs that comprise the award-winning Ann Arbor Art Fair, attracting nearly 400,000 visitors each year.

Your work deserves to be seen. Your talent deserves to be celebrated. And your next great art fair experience could start here.

Important Show Information:  Please review the application procedures, the event calendar and the Exhibition Standards and Rules.  If you have any questions, please contact The Guild at 734.662.3382 or info@theguild.org.

  • Live music
