items.name: One of a Kind Spring Show Chicago 2027
items.shortDescription: The One of a Kind Spring Show  is a 3-day show featuring fine art and craft from a juried selection of talented artists in a premier location at THE MART in downtown Chicago. We invite artists, designers and makers with high quality, handmade, original work to apply to be part of the One of a Kind Spring experience!  Eligible work ranges from giftable craft to premium fine art.  Applicants will be juried and chosen based on uniqueness, craftsmanship and attention to detail.

items.name: Rising Eyes of Texas 2027
items.shortDescription:
RISING EYES OF TEXAS

Every year, Rockport Center for the Arts hosts a statewide, juried exhibition for undergraduate and graduate students emerging in the visual arts. Cash prizes are awarded for first, second and third place.

Submission fees are just $5 for up to three artwork submissions. 

Past jurors have been 2026 - Elena Rodz (2026 Master Artist and past curator of exhibitons for Rockport Center for the Arts), 2025 - Sara Morgan (Director, Art Museum of South Texas), 2024 - Tracy Saucier (director of the Beeville Art Museum), 2023 - Tanja Peterson (gallery director, Redbud Arts Center), 2022 - Joseph Cohen (artist, and founder of Davis Cohen Fine Art), 2021 - Rigoberta Luna (co-owner Presa House), 2020 - Rebecca Gomez (independent curator, former curator Mexic-arte Museum), 2019 - Hollis Hammonds (Professor of Art, St. Edwards University), 2018 - Rainey Knudson (founder of Glasstire).

2026 Rising Eyes of Texas Exhibition Date: February 27 - March 29, 2026. Submission Deadline: EXTENDED through Sunday, February 8th, 2026 (11:59 pm CST). If selected for the exhibition, Accept Invitation Deadline: Thursday, February 12th. Artwork Drop-off: February 15-24, 2026.

items.name: OneAmerica Financial Broad Ripple Art Fair at the Indy Art Center 55th Annual 2027
items.shortDescription:
Now celebrating its 55th year, the Indy Art Center’s OneAmerica Financial Foundation Broad Ripple Art Fair attracts an average of 10,000 visitors and offers an opportunity for the public to meet fine art & craft artists from the U.S. and Canada.
The OneAmerica Financial Foundation Broad Ripple Art Fair is located on the grounds of the Indy Art Center designed by Hoosier Architect Michael Graves and its 9.5-acre ARTSPARK. Located in the Broad Ripple Village Cultural District— a cultural arts, shopping, night club, and dining district—the Indy Art Center is next to the popular Monon Trail urban greenway.

items.name: Dollar Bank Three Rivers Arts Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
The 2027 Dollar Bank Three Rivers Arts Festival returns to its new home in Arts Landing – following the transformative outdoor civic space’s debut in 2026, the Pittsburgh Cultural Trust once again welcomes Cultural District visitors, artists and patrons to a vibrant atmosphere where the Great Lawn, family play areas, and public art are amplified through the myriad of local, national and international artists with the Festival.

The full Festival lineup will be announced in the spring of 2027. The 2027 Dollar Bank Three Rivers Arts Festival is scheduled to take place the first two weekends in June; June 4-6 (Friday-Sunday) and June 10-13 (Thursday-Sunday).


Complimentary Jury Coupon Codes for Eligible Artists:

  • AW2026 - 2026 Award Winners
  • EA2027 - 2027 Emerging Artist Applicants (must live within 150 miles of the festival and have never done an outdoor festival before). Please add a 6th image of your work if you do not have a Booth Shot.
  • EA2 - Emerging Artist II Applicants (only eligible to the eight 2026 Emerging Artists)
  • AB2027 - Advisory Board Members

2027 Booth Fees: 
  • June 4-6  $500
  • June 5-6  $500
  • June 10-13  $600
  • June 12-13 $500
  • June 4-6 & June 10-13  $1100

items.name: East Grand Rapids Fine Art Fair 2027
items.shortDescription:
East Grand Rapids Fine Art Fair

Gaslight Village | East Grand Rapids, Michigan
June 18–20, 2027
Produced by The Guild of Artists & Artisans

Discover Art in the Heart of Gaslight Village

Join us for the second annual East Grand Rapids Fine Art Fair, a vibrant celebration of fine art, fine craft, and community in the heart of Gaslight Village. Set along Wealthy Street SE, from Croswell Avenue SE to East Grand Rapids High School, this inviting event brings together approximately 100 jury-selected artists in one of West Michigan’s most appealing shopping and dining destinations.

With convenient parking, distinctive shops, and wonderful restaurants just steps away, the fair offers an engaging experience for art enthusiasts, collectors, and the local community. Visitors can explore exceptional, original artwork, enjoy live music, participate in art activities, and take advantage of the area’s Social District—all in a lively, welcoming atmosphere.

Connect with an art-loving audience, showcase your work, and be part of a growing community tradition that celebrates creativity and craftsmanship.

Important Show Information

Before applying, please review the application procedures, event calendar, and Exhibition Standards and Rules. For questions, contact The Guild of Artists & Artisans at 734.662.3382, ext. 2, or info@theguild.org.

items.name: Art in the Pass 2027
items.shortDescription:
ART IN THE PASS INVITES ARTISTS TO APPLY FOR THE 29th ANNUAL EVENT TO BE HELD IN PASS CHRISTIAN MS APRIL 3RD & 4TH, 2027

The Board of Art in the Pass, Pass Christian Main Street and the people of Pass Christian, MS invite you to apply to our 29th annual juried fine arts festival. AitP features 100 arts vendors spread throughout scenic War Memorial Park.  This Mississippi Gulf Coast venue overlooks white sand beaches and beautiful gulf waters. For 29 years, AitP has attracted thousands of art patrons to our historic coastal community.

Please apply to join us April 3 & 4, 2027 to share your talents with approximately 10,000 visitors from throughout the region.  Pass Christian is a special place with a special place in our hearts for artists. We hope you will apply and experience our incomparable Southern hospitality and picture-perfect location.

Proceeds from Art in the Pass fund college scholarships for local art students and grants to art programs in area schools.

Celebrate the Gulf Marine Education Festival on Saturday.  The student art show is Sunday.
Location: Memorial Park 300 E. Scenic Drive
Pass Christian, Mississippi (South East)

items.name: Art Birmingham 2027 - 46th Year
items.shortDescription:
46th Annual ART BIRMINGHAM

A Celebrated Mother’s Day Tradition

May 8–9, 2027 | Downtown Birmingham, Michigan

Produced by the Birmingham Bloomfield Art Center in association with The Guild of Artists & Artisans

Be Part of One of Michigan’s Favorite Art Fair Traditions

Celebrate the start of Michigan’s outdoor art fair season at Art Birmingham, a highly regarded juried fine art and fine craft fair set in the heart of beautiful downtown Birmingham, Michigan.

Held in and around picturesque Shain Park, Art Birmingham brings together talented artists, enthusiastic collectors, and discerning shoppers for a memorable weekend of original art, creativity, and community. The elegant downtown setting, surrounded by distinctive boutiques, acclaimed restaurants, and convenient parking, offers an inviting experience for both artists and visitors.

A beloved Mother’s Day weekend destination, Art Birmingham offers participating artists the opportunity to showcase their work in a vibrant, upscale community with an appreciation for quality craftsmanship and original art.

Join us for a standout weekend and help kick off Michigan’s outdoor art fair season!

Important Show Information:  Please review the application procedures, the event calendar and the Exhibition Standards and Rules.  If you have any questions, please contact The Guild at 734.662.3382, ext. 301 or info@theguild.org.

items.name: Charlevoix Waterfront Art Fair 2027
items.shortDescription:
For 68 years, the Charlevoix Waterfront Art Fair, the second oldest juried art fair in Michigan, has been bringing fine art to our community. Held in grassy East Park on Round Lake, the natural harbor between Lakes Michigan and Charlevoix, makes for a unique and beautiful setting for the event. The variety of art, the range of techniques, and the array of colors across the park make the Charlevoix Waterfront Art Fair a spectacular visual experience. These exceptional qualities set the Art Fair apart from other shows.

The emphasis of the show is and always has been on ART and creativity. It is that focus that attracts some of the nation’s top artists as well as enthusiastic and knowledgeable patrons to our city. From the insightful individuals who took the initiative to bring fine arts to Charlevoix sixty-eight years ago to the continued commitment to ensure the proceeds from the fair benefit arts education in our community, artistic creativity is always at the forefront.

The Charlevoix Waterfront Art Fair, in tandem with the Council for the Arts, will continue supporting the next generation of artists and fostering creativity in our community. Our goal is to provide year-round inspiration and opportunity for aspiring young local artists and to foster an appreciation of the arts.

The Waterfront Art Fair has an outstanding reputation with critics, collectors, and artists because of both the quality of art and the unparalleled location.

items.name: Bonita Art Celebration 2027
items.shortDescription:
Join us for the inaugural Bonita Art Celebration, a juried outdoor fine art show presented by Naples Picasso Events on March 13 and 14, 2027.

The event will take place on the expansive grassy field at 28001 Old 41 Rd, Bonita Springs, FL 34135, at the highly visible corner of Old 41 and Bonita Beach Road. This prominent location offers exceptional exposure, convenient access, ample onsite parking, and plenty of space for a professionally designed artist layout.

The Bonita Art Celebration will feature original works by accomplished artists in painting, sculpture, photography, mixed media, jewelry, glass, ceramics, and other fine art categories.

Participating artists will benefit from strong event marketing, a highly visible location in the heart of Bonita Springs, free onsite overnight parking, professional show organization, overnight security, and a spacious outdoor setting.

A major advantage for artists is the Friday setup the day before the show, allowing exhibitors to prepare their booths without having to arrive early Saturday morning.

Our goal is to create a high quality, artist focused event that attracts serious art buyers, seasonal residents, visitors, and collectors from throughout Southwest Florida.

items.name: Mercato Art Celebration 2027 4th Annual
items.shortDescription:
Join us for the 4th Annual Mercato Art Celebration, an exceptional fine art show presented by Naples Picasso Events. Taking place on the prestigious streets of Mercato, this is Naples’ only art show held mainly on a closed street

Set in one of Naples’ most vibrant and upscale districts, this curated outdoor celebration showcases world-class fine art in a setting surrounded by luxury boutiques, gourmet dining, and lively entertainment. Stroll the palm-lined avenues and explore original works from renowned national and international artists, featuring painting, sculpture, photography, mixed media, and more.

For participating artists, the Mercato Art Celebration offers:

  • Premium exposure and targeted advertising

  • 24-hour security and high foot traffic

  • Professional show layout and tent rentals

  • A discerning, art-loving audience in one of Florida’s wealthiest communities

  • A stylish, walkable venue that is closed to traffic

  • Top-tier artwork in a refined atmosphere

  • On-site restrooms, dining, and drinks

  • Easy parking and smooth artist setup

  • No park-related inconveniences, just art, sunshine, and sophistication

items.name: Art on the Square Cornell Art Museum February 2027
items.shortDescription:
APPLICATION DEADLINE:  December 9, 2026     ACCEPTANCE:  Artists will be notified via email of acceptance by December 21, 2026

ART SHOW LOCATION:  Cornell Art Museum at Old School Square (51 N. Swinton Avenue, Delray Beach, FL 33444)
Museum Front Lawn and Swinton West Lawn 

ARTIST BOOTH FEES: Upon acceptance of application, booth fees will be due asap before January 11, 2027 (Fees will be charged on credit card provided on January 11, 2027) 

 Artist Application Deadline: December 16, 2026
 Artist Notification:  December 18, 2026

Art on the Square is a two-day Premiere Juried Outdoor Fine Art Show presented by the Cornell Art Museum at Old School Square (51 N. Swinton Avenue, Delray Beach FL 33444). This outdoor art gallery features original works of art by fine artists from around the country.  Beautifully located on the grounds of the Cornell Art Museum at Old School Square in the heart of Downtown Delray Beach, this show welcomes thousands of visitors to stroll the historic grounds, meet the artists to acquire wonderful original art while enjoying live music and refreshments. Art on the Square offers a unique art experience for everyone.  This event has a proven record with seven successfully produced fine art shows by Marusca Gatto, Cultural Arts Director, for the Downtown Development Authority, the organization managing and operating the Cornell Art Museum.

items.name: Talbot Street Art Fair 2027
items.shortDescription: Talbot Street Art Fair, Inc. invites you to submit your entry to the oldest juried art fair in Central Indiana, founded in 1956. Our long standing reputation has established this show as a top quality, juried exhibition of fine arts and fine crafts. Talbot Street Art Fair is held in Indianapolis, Indiana in the picturesque Herron-Morton neighborhood which graciously hosts us each year; this area is full of quaint restaurants and coffee shops and is close to downtown Indianapolis. We have strong community support thanks to our intensive marketing with local tv, radio and social media which draws approximately 60,000 attendees annually. Customers are loyal and come rain or shine, hot or cold.  We pride ourselves on continuing to offer free admission to this beloved, family-friendly event. The fair provides security at every entry point and patrols regularly. Overnight security is provided in addition to daytime support.

items.name: Cherry Creek Arts Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
Join one of the nation’s most highly regarded art shows! CherryArts invites you to apply for the 2027 Cherry Creek Arts Festival and be among 260 exceptional exhibitors featured at this world-class celebration of art.
 
Each year, the festival welcomes more than 145,000 visitors and offers artists an unparalleled experience, including:
  • Strong art sales potential (2026 Artist Survey reported an average of $17,916 per artist)
  • Consistently high national rankings
  • On-site artist amenities
  • A new jury panel each year for fresh perspective
With a loyal, art-savvy audience that includes many collectors, the Cherry Creek Arts Festival is a proven place to exhibit and sell your work. Don't miss your chance to be part of one of the country's top shows!
   
CherryArts is a Denver-based nonprofit that believes access to art is for everyone and that artists are essential. Through year-round outreach programs and this iconic festival, we support artists and arts education. With an estimated $4.5 million in annual art sales, the festival remains a vital platform for artists' success.

items.name: Foothills Art Market 2027
items.shortDescription:
The Foothills Art Market showcases original artwork, handcrafted goods, and one of a kind creations from talented Colorado artisans. Customers can explore an impressive selection of work across a variety of disciplines, including pottery, painting, glass, jewelry, fashion, soaps, home décor, photography, and more. With so many unique pieces to discover and purchase, the market offers something for everyone.

Foothills Park & Recreation District - Arts & Events Department offers visual and performing arts classes, community events, art in the park, and a summer concert series for the residents of South Jefferson County benefiting all artists in Colorado.

items.name: Holy Moly: Breaking News
items.shortDescription:
In continuation of our Holy Moly series of exhibitions, Niza Knoll Gallery invites local Colorado artists to submit artwork in the theme of Holy Moly: Breaking News.

Is news breaking? Or is the news broken?
We are constantly confronted with “Breaking News” on every TV, internet and social media channel. New information. Events in progress. Some more shocking or surreal than the rest. At times, new information doesn't feel new. Real-time events feel predictable. And, when the rights of the free press are being taken away, we as consumers can easily find ourselves wary—and weary—of the tagline itself and the content that follows. 

Use your artistic skills to reflect the theme as you interpret it.

items.name: Ridgway Rendezvous Arts & Craft Festival 2027, 42nd Annual
items.shortDescription:
42nd Annual Ridgway Rendezvous Arts & Craft Festival

2027 marks the 42nd Annual Ridgway Rendezvous Arts & Craft Festival, hosted by Weehawken Creative Arts. This juried show is dedicated to showcasing beautiful artwork, quality craftsmanship, and unique handmade items that are not easily found in our region. Many returning participants regard the Ridgway Rendezvous as “one of their best shows of the year" or "one of their favorite shows of the year."

The event attracts affluent clientele, including local and regional art collectors, second homeowners, and vacationers from across the United States. The weekend runs alongside Telluride Jazz Fest & captures traveling festival clientele as well. 

This 2-day festival features live music, a beer, wine, and cocktail tent, and a variety of children's activities, creating a vibrant, community and family-friendly atmosphere.

Location:
Historic Downtown Ridgway's "Hartwell Town Park" offers a picturesque setting for the event, surrounded by the Cimarron & Sneffels Mountain Ranges. The park is situated at the junction of Highways 550 & 62 along the San Juan Scenic Byway, attracting travelers heading to and from Durango, Silverton, Ouray & Telluride.

Awards:
Best in Show, Best in Category, Best Booth Display, Best Festival Vibe, and the new "Double Take" award

“You take wonderful care of the vendors – we felt welcomed & loved all the water, treats, etc. Thank you!!! Please continue to advertise – great job!” 

-Previous Artist

items.name: Riverboxes 20th Anniversary Commission
items.shortDescription:
REQUEST FOR QUALIFICATIONS

In celebration of the 20th anniversary of RiverboxesTM, Dublin Arts Council (DAC) is seeking to commission five Ohio-based artists to create original site-specific, permanent interactive public artworks to serve as “Riverbox” vessels as part of DAC’s RiverboxesTM program. 

Each Riverbox will include an artist-designed stamp and logbook that supports site-based exploration. DAC will develop publicly accessible location clues and interpretive materials via the RiverboxesTM passport to support community engagement, exploration, and repeat visitation.

items.name: Earth & Fire 2027
items.shortDescription:
Earth & Fire 2027 is a national, juried, exhibition of ceramic art held annually in Wheeling, WV in February and March. The jurors this year are Dr. Benjamin Evans and Wayne Higby, the current and former Director of the Alfred Ceramic Art Museum. This is the 5th annual exhibition and will be the focal point of our Ceramics Take Over Wheeling conference.

Ceramics Take Over Wheeling is a citywide event celebrating ceramic artists and enthusiasts alike. Galleries and venues across the “Friendly City” are excited to showcase the very best in contemporary and traditional ceramic art during this intimate 4-day ceramics festival.

The awards will be:

1st prize: $4000.00, solo exhibition, jury opportunity, and paid workshop / demo / talk in 2028.

2nd prize: $1500.00

3rd prize: $1000.00

2 merit awards: $250.00 each

Entry fee: $35.00 for up to 2 pieces

items.name: Intercollegiate Ceramics 2027
items.shortDescription:
West Liberty University will host the national exhibition of collegiate ceramic art in February and March 2027. This exhibit will celebrate and honor the college ceramic artist and run in conjunction with Earth & Fire 2027. The juror will be Earth & Fire 2026 best in show artist Matthew Skelly.

Intercollegiate Ceramics 2027 is the kick-off event for Ceramics Take Over Wheeling, a citywide event celebrating ceramic artists and enthusiasts alike. Galleries and venues across the “Friendly City” are excited to showcase the very best in contemporary and traditional ceramic art during this incredible 4-day ceramics festival.

The awards will be:

1st prize: $2000.00, solo exhibition, and paid demo opportunity in 2028.

2nd prize: $500.00

3rd prize: $350.00

2 merit awards: $75.00 each

Entry fee: $20.00 for up to 3 pieces

items.name: Rittenhouse Square Fine Art Show - 100th Annual, June 2027
items.shortDescription:
The Rittenhouse Square Fine Art Show is proud to be consistently recognized as one of
the best Fine Art Shows in the country. Several important features distinguish our shows from
other art shows.

Only original, non-functional fine art is accepted. The shows are led by a non-profit
organization of fellow professional artists. The Board of Directors exhibits in both annual
shows, creating an energetic, vested interest in success. Our focus on extensive marketing with
the show’s website, social media, emailed newsletters, regional outdoor signage, and targeted
advertising has propelled customer growth in the market. These factors, along with
the consistent excellence of our artists, have contributed to a 99-year history of distinction. 

June 4th - 6th 2027
The 100th Annual June Rittenhouse Square Fine Art Show

There will be 145 available artist spaces. The venue is the perimeter of Rittenhouse Square, a
prestigious park setting in Center City Philadelphia. Surrounded by some of the most luxurious
residential addresses in the city, the show consistently attracts an affluent, culturally educated
clientele. 

In short, if you are a fine artist interested in a well-run urban show that offers an arts savvy
audience, a beautiful venue, and a community of high-quality exhibitors, then the Rittenhouse
Square Fine Art Show (RSFAS) should be on your schedule.

items.name: Mission Fed ArtWalk 2027
items.shortDescription:
San Diego's longest running and largest art festival (43 years in 2027!) is in the city's Little Italy district. The charming venue is San Diego's dining mecca, which on any weekend attracts thousands. During the ArtWalk weekend, the neighborhood is filled with over 100,000 art lovers that travel from all over the USA to attend. Occupying 15 blocks of the district, artists may request from a wide variety of locations. Each city block has its own unique character!

Artists benefit from an extensive marketing, publicity and social media campaigns, with a strong presence in radio and television as well as print and online advertising. Considered one of San Diego's top public festivals, the attendance grows each year. Marketing pieces are provided for participating artists to distribute.

The ArtWalk San Diego team is well-known for our artist-focused management style, and our attentive staff and volunteers.

ArtWalk San Diego events help to support ArtReach, our not for profit partner that delivers high quality visual art education in schools throughout San Diego County, that have no other resources or budget for art.

items.name: Southwest Arts Festival® 2027
items.shortDescription: We cordially invite you to apply for the 40th Annual Southwest Arts Festival®, presented by The Greater Coachella Valley Chamber of Commerce.  This highly acclaimed Festival is held at Acrisure Arena. The festival has previously had over 200 acclaimed artists showing traditional, contemporary, and abstract fine works of art and quality crafts. The festival is a major, internationally recognized cultural event. Be a part of one of the best art shows in the nation.

items.name: Isle of Eight Flags Shrimp Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
ANNUAL ISLE OF EIGHT FLAGS SHRIMP FESTIVAL
Fine Art & Crafts Show in Historic Fernandina Beach
on Beautiful Amelia Island, Florida

  
The Fine Art and Crafts portion of this show is administered by the Island Art Association, Inc. in conjunction with the Isle of Eight Flags Shrimp Festival Committee.  This show is an annual juried event consistently rated by “Sunshine Artist Magazine” in the top 200 of North America’s best events. 
   
The street festival features fine art and crafts, antiques, food, open air entertainment and special events, providing an excellent atmosphere to exhibit and sell your work.  Annually, over 100,000 visitors are expected for the 3-day event.

items.name: Naples Artcrafters February 2027 Show (Fine Artist and Fine Artcrafters)
items.shortDescription:
We are one of the oldest arts organizations supporting Fine Arts and Crafts and local Artists in the Naples Florida area over 65+ years of experience!
Intrested in donating to Naples Art Crafters? Click here
If artist is accepted, upon receiving acceptance they will be required to purchase the booth fee at the Naples Artcrafters store.

Naples Artcrafters is a show that specializes in fine art. In bussiness for over 65 years, our show season runs from November through April. Our monthly shows are free to the public and are held on Saturdays in Cambier Park in downtown Naples.

Show hours are 10 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. 

Cambier Park is one block south of Fifth Avenue in downtown Naples and is in walking distance to many fine restaurants, boutiques, and galleries. Parking for the Cambier Park shows is free and available in the public parking garage adjacent to the park in downtown Naples.

items.name: Spring Festival on Ponce:(17th Annual) 2027, North Druid Hills, Atlanta, Ga
items.shortDescription:
Festival on Ponce is ideal for artists seeking strong early-season sales, meaningful collector interactions, and a polished Atlanta market. Space is limited and early applications are encouraged.

Spring Festival on Ponce, established in 2010, is a premier spring outdoor arts festival held along Atlanta’s historic Olmsted Linear Park and is widely regarded as the unofficial kickoff to the Atlanta festival season. Taking place each spring on Ponce de Leon Avenue, the festival attracts motivated art buyers and collectors eager to begin the season.

This carefully curated event features fine art and high-quality craftsmanship across a wide range of media. The linear park setting provides continuous foot traffic, extended patron engagement, and an elegant backdrop that enhances the presentation of artwork. Festival on Ponce consistently draws a discerning audience from some of Atlanta’s most established and affluent neighborhoods.

Artists benefit from professional event management, strong regional marketing, and a reputation built over more than a decade of successful shows. With limited booth space and a competitive jury process, Festival on Ponce offers artists an exceptional opportunity to launch their festival season in one of Atlanta’s most respected spring arts events.

Festival Hours: Saturday 10:00 am-5:00 pm, Sunday 11:00 am – 5:00 pm

items.name: Westport Fine Arts Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
Westport Fine Arts Festival is a notable highlight for collectors and residents from the Tri-State region, New England, and beyond. Our nationally recognized, juried festival features a premier roster of regional, national, and international fine artists exhibiting in a variety of media categories - including painting, photography, sculpture, fiber, printmaking, mixed media, glass, ceramics, jewelry, wood, graphics, and printmaking. All artwork is available for purchase in a wide variety of price ranges, subject matter, and styles. 

This art festival is free to the public, and there will be on-site food vending, live music, and hands-on art projects and demonstrations for children and adults.

Westport Fine Arts Festival also welcomes interest from potential sponsors. Please contact the Operations Director at operations@westportdowntown.com

The Westport Fine Arts Festival is presented and produced by The Westport Downtown Association, with Artist Direction by Sue Brown Gordon of Gordon Fine Arts, who can be reached at FAFDirector@westportdowntown.com or directly at (518) 852-6478.

items.name: Sandy Springs Artsapalooza Spring:(16th Annual) 2027, Sandy Springs, Ga
items.shortDescription:
Sandy Springs Artsapalooza is a popular two-day outdoor arts festival held annually in Sandy Springs, just north of Atlanta. Produced by (AFFPS), the event is part of AFFPS’s long-running mission to bring high-quality visual art into accessible public spaces while supporting working artists.

The festival features approximately 100 juried artists and craftspeople from across the Southeast, showcasing original, handmade work in a wide range of media including painting, photography, jewelry, ceramics, sculpture, fiber, glass, metal, and mixed media. All artwork is created and presented by the artists themselves, giving attendees a direct connection to the makers.

Artsapalooza is free to attend and designed as a community-friendly event. In addition to artist booths, visitors can enjoy live music, food vendors and food trucks, children’s art activities, and interactive experiences that make the festival welcoming for families and casual art buyers as well as serious collectors. One of the festival’s signature traditions is its massive Easter celebration, where AFFPS distributes more than 10,000 Easter eggs, making it one of the most enthusiastically attended and family-loved arts events in the region.

Sandy Springs Artsapalooza has become a signature cultural event for the city, blending fine art, community engagement, and neighborhood vitality—hallmarks of AFFPS-produced festivals across Atlanta.

Festival Hours: Saturday 10:00 am-5:00 pm, Sunday 11:00 am – 5:00 pm

items.name: Allentown Art Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
• Held annually during the second weekend in June in Buffalo, New York, The Allentown Art Festival, formally designated as a "Local Legacy " and cultural treasure by the United States Library of Congress, is one of the country's most respected open air art celebrations. This year we are celebrating our 70th milestone annual show. This juried, non profit event transforms the historic Allentown neighborhood, spanning Delaware Avenue, Allen, Virginia and Allen streets into a vibrant art gallery. More than 350 juried artists across media including painting, sculpture, photography, ceramics, jewelry, mixed media, wood, leather and fiber participate in the show. The festival combines high caliber fine art with live demonstrations, local food vendors, music and dance. When you exhibit with us, you join a vibrant community of national and regional creators. Set against the backdrop of our historic neighborhood, the festival draws massive, enthusiastic crowds of dedicated art lovers and buyers. We pride ourselves on creating a warm environment for artists to showcase artists' talent and extraordinary works. 
  • The Allentown Art Festival has deep community roots that support funding for childrens' art programs throughout western New York. Our mission is to support the arts in Buffalo. Each year we award over $25,000.00 in college scholarships to Western New York students who intend to major in art.

items.name: Artsplosure - The Raleigh Arts Festival 2027
items.shortDescription: Artsplosure - The Raleigh Arts Festival is one of the most original, longest running, and best-attended arts festivals in North Carolina. The 2-day event (Saturday, May 15 and Sunday, May 16) is held annually on the third weekend of May in beautiful downtown Raleigh. The festival’s centerpiece is an Art Market comprised of approximately 175 juried visual artists from across the United States showcasing works in ceramics, glass, fiber art, jewelry, metal, painting, photography, wood and more. Artsplosure presents national and regional entertainment on two stages, provides arts-based activities for children and families, and presents large-scale temporary art installations each year. Annual festival attendance averages over 85,000.

items.name: Wigwam Festival of Fine Art 2027
items.shortDescription:
Wigwam Festival of Fine Art  ~ 17th Annual

The Wigwam Festival of Fine Art, located on the grounds of Arizona's most iconic Wigwam Resort, offers a weekend filled with exceptional fine art, wine and cocktails, food, and live musical entertainment. The award winning festival creates a stunning outdoor gallery on the majestic front lawn, framed by towering palms and flower gardens, offering an idyllic setting for art affectionados, collectors and festival-goers alike.

With over 125 best in class artists and fine craftsmen showcasing their original works, attendees can expect a diverse array of high-quality fine art and craftsmanship, including bronze, clay, wooe, glass, and metal sculptures, spectacular paintings, intricate wood work, sparkling hand-blown glass, colorful ceramics, fine photography, handcrafted one of a kind jewelry, boutique items, and more!

Adding to the festival experience are amenities such as a cash bar, al fresco dining options, and live musical performances. These elements enrich the ambiance, allowing visitors to immerse themselves fully in the cultural and sensory delights of the event.

What's more, the festival offers free admission and free parking, making it accessible to everyone who wishes to explore and enjoy this celebration of art and creativity in a picturesque Arizona setting.

items.name: Bloomin’ Arts Festival 56th Annual 2027
items.shortDescription:
55 Years of Being Central Florida’s Favorite Fine Art and Fine Craft Show. Saturday & Sunday March 6-7,2027. Additional free attractions draw the crowds. This is a juried show with awards of over $12,000.

Held in Historic downtown Bartow, Florida. In addition to juried artists, we also have student art tent, a quilt show in the Polk History Center, flower show, car show, bicycle race, kids activities tent and live music.

Our event is growing every year, and 2025 was another great success.

items.name: VisArts' Rockville Arts Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
The 15th Annual VisArts' Rockville Arts Festival invites you to showcase your original art, May 1-2, 2027. A premier event in a spectacular venue produced by VisArts - the largest visual arts center in Montgomery County Maryland. This festival will create a spectacular outdoor pedestrian gallery on the streets of Rockville Town Square where Every Booth is a Corner.

The Festival attracts 10-12,000+ high income attendees from the Washington, DC Metro Area, and surrounding suburbs of Rockville, Bethesda, and Chevy Chase. Cultural events are an important dynamic in this affluent community.

Our extensive marketing and PR campaigns include a dedicated PR team that is amazing at getting artist stories in the local papers and on television and partners with the 12 Rockville cultural organizations, invests heavily in social media, digital and print media.  Our media outreach is prolific and effective.

items.name: Omaha Art Fair 2027
items.shortDescription:
Greetings Artists! The Omaha Art Fair is in it’s third year, drawing an estimated 30,000 fair goers and art patrons from around the Omaha metro and regional area (population over 960,000). The fair is located in Omaha’s Aksarben Village and Stinson Park. This 3-day fair features professional artwork, interactive art for fairgoers, food trucks & adult beverages, live music, and is FREE for patrons.

Omaha Art Fair invites up to 166 juried artisans from across the country in a variety of mediums to participate in the event.

We are organized and run by a board comprised of professional artists, community leaders, and event planning experts. Artist feedback from previous years is incorporated in the planning of the Omaha Art Fair.


The Omaha Art Fair does not accept applications for soap, candles, manufactured items or foods, and absolutely no resellers.

items.name: Pennsylvania Guild of Craftsmen Summer Fine Craft Fair Foundry 48 Lititz PA - 2027
items.shortDescription:
SAME SHOW! NEW WEEKEND!

For our 2027 Summer Fine Craft Fair, we return to the beautiful, climate-controlled, easy-to-access Foundry 48 Event Center in Lititz, PA. Located in beautiful Lancaster County and situated just off PA Rt. 501 N, this event will draw patrons from Lancaster, Lititz, Reading, Chester, and regional cities such as Philadelphia, Wilmington & Baltimore. 

PGC’s Summer Fine Craft Fair features full & half booth spaces for up to 75 artists, many of whom do not exhibit at outdoor venues. The variety of quality fine art & craft mediums will entice shoppers who appreciate handmade items versus mass production they can buy anywhere. Fair hours are 10-5 Saturday and Sunday, June 26 & 27. Admission is $10 for adults, with early discount tickets available online at www.pacrafts.org.
 
Foundry 48 is 2 miles south of the center of Lititz, PA - America's Coolest Small Town and nine miles north of downtown Lancaster, PA.  The Fine Craft Fair is open to artists from across the country.  

Master Artisan members of the PGC are eligible for consideration by the Floor Jury for monetary Benchmark Awards.

items.name: Capital Art and Craft Festival – December 2026
items.shortDescription:
The Capital Art and Craft Festival, a juried festival, draws buyers from Virginia, Maryland, DC, and beyond. CACF has hosted numerous festivals welcoming thousands of art and craft connoisseurs in search of unique pieces of art for themselves, personal collections, and as gifts. The festival will be held at the New DTC Expo Center in Sterling, VA where artists will engage with a diverse audience of art and fine craft enthusists who are looking to purchase items for personal collections, gifts, fashionable clothing, home decor and more.  The new two level DTC Expo Center is attached to Dulles Town Center which offers plenty of free parking, easy access and of course, Indoors.

Capital Art and Craft Festivals are produced by SPARGO, Inc., the largest, independently owned, full-service event management company in the United States with over 53 years of experience. Our focus is on producing artist-friendly festivals which bring art/craft buyers and our artists together.

items.name: Gulf Breeze Celebrates the Arts 2027
items.shortDescription:
The city of Gulf Breeze and Gulf Breeze Arts, Inc. are proud to host the 31st Gulf Breeze Celebrates the Arts Festival, held on April 3 and 4 in Gulf Breeze, Florida. This two day event is a staple event for the city of Gulf Breeze, which is a beautiful little city located between Pensacola and Pensacola Beach, just a short drive from the white sands of the Gulf of Mexico. We are excited to host 100+ local, regional and national fine artists, food vendors, a Local Artists Art Show, a Silent Auction well as live artist demonstrations and childrens activities. We are lined up behind the Orange Beach Arts Festival and the Fairhope Arts Festival, making these three festivals a perfect line up for the month of March and April.
Gulf Breeze Arts, Inc. prides itself in donating the proceeds of the GBAF to local school art enhancement programs to help with supplies and projects as well as an endowed scholarship fund at Pensacola State College.  As of 2026, GBAI has donated over $200,000. We would be unable to do this without the participation of our artists, such as yourself, so thank you for your participation and support.

items.name: Wyandotte Street Art Fair 2027
items.shortDescription:
We warmly invite you to submit your application for the 66th Annual Wyandotte Street Art Fair (WSAF), held every July in the heart of Wyandotte, Michigan. This four-day event, voted one of the 200 Best Shows in America by Sunshine Artist, yearly “Best Local Festival” and one of the "Best Street Fairs" by the Detroit Free Press as part of their Best of the Best Community Choice Awards, brings together over 300 artists and crafters from across the country, showcasing their work to nearly 250,000 attendees. As one of the largest and second-longest running art fairs in the state, we encourage you to apply and be part of this celebrated event. Please review the attached rules and regulations for more details.
 
You will be notified of acceptance in April 2027. Special requests concerning location and space will be considered, but cannot be made a condition of participation.

items.name: Decatur Arts Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
The Decatur Arts Festival is produced by the Decatur Arts Alliance, a 501(c)3 organization that connects local residents, businesses, tourists, and artists to increase arts access and engagement in Decatur, Georgia.

The Decatur Arts Alliance invites you to apply for booth space in the 37th annual Decatur Arts Festival. The festival will be held on the newly renovated square in historic Decatur, GA, just minutes from downtown Atlanta.

The Decatur Arts Festival brings the community together through a multi-day offering of live music, dance, comedy, theatrical performances, exhibitions, and an expansive and diverse Artists’ Market.  Annual attendence is estimated to be 50,000.

The Artists' Market will be open on Saturday, May 1st, from 10am until 6pm, and on Sunday, May 2nd, from 11am until 5pm.

items.name: Grand Haven Art Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
FRIDAY 12pm - 5pm, SATURDAY 10am-5pm, SUNDAY 11am - 4pm

The Grand Haven Art Festival is a community event inviting nearly 95 artists from across the country to transform Washington Avenue into a chic, outdoor art gallery.
Located inside the Grand Haven Social District! *

Ranked in the Top 200 Shows by Sunshine Artist Magazine, this well-attended event boasts free admission, food vendors, and kids’ activities. Residents and visitors from Grand Rapids, Chicago, Detroit, and more visit the Annual Grand Haven Art Festival looking to purchase that perfect piece for their homes, cottages, and offices. 

The goal of the Grand Haven Art Festival is to provide the communities and visitors of the West Michigan area with a unique opportunity to purchase one-of-a-kind art, directly from the artist. The 66th Annual Grand Haven Art Festival is coordinated by The Chamber of Commerce - Grand Haven, Spring Lake, Ferrysburg with the assistance of a local committee. The Chamber of Commerce has been affiliated with the Art Festival since its beginning. Join us as we celebrate the arts in Grand Haven, Michigan!

Stay connected on Facebook!
*Subject to change based on city regulations and policies.

items.name: Stevens Point Area Festival of the Arts 2027
items.shortDescription:
The Stevens Point Area Festival of the Arts (FoA) celebrates its 53rd year on Sunday, April 4, 2027, from 10 AM–4 PM at our indoor venue, Artist & Fare and O’so Brewing Company in Plover, Wisconsin, just outside Stevens Point in the heart of Central Wisconsin.

This juried fine art and fine craft festival features 51 artist booths and offers free admission, ample parking, a free Kids Art Zone, and an art raffle supporting local art education grants.

Organized by working artists and dedicated art-loving volunteers, the FoA is committed to celebrating creativity, supporting professional artists, and strengthening arts education in our community. We take pride in creating a welcoming, well-organized event that benefits both exhibiting artists and visitors.

Join us for this one-day celebration of art and help kick off the 2027 spring art festival season!

items.name: Fairhope Arts and Crafts Festival - FOOD COURT 2027
items.shortDescription:
2027 - 75th ANNUAL FAIRHOPE ARTS AND CRAFTS FESTIVAL

For the past 75 years, artists and craftsmen have come to Fairhope, Alabama to celebrate the arts. Our beautiful downtown along the Eastern Shore of Mobile Bay will host the 74th Fairhope Arts and Crafts Festival March 19-21, 2027.  
 
The Fairhope Arts and Crafts Committee, Festival Foundation, and Food Court with the additional support from the City of Fairhope hope you join us for our annual festival where artists and foodies are treated to our own brand of “Southern Hospitality.”  

The hours for the 2027 festival are Friday-Sunday 10 am to 5pm.  

We look forward to seeing you setting up your booth Thursday March 18, 2027 at 6:00pm.

items.name: Cottonwood Art Festival Spring 2027
items.shortDescription:
Located in Richardson, Texas, just minutes from Dallas, the award-winning Cottonwood Art Festival is a premier juried art show featuring more than 200 talented artists showcasing their work beneath towering oak trees in a beautiful lakeside setting.

Recognized as one of the nation’s top fine art festivals, Cottonwood continues to uphold its reputation as a first-class event with a rich history spanning more than 58 years. Produced by the City of Richardson, the festival attracts a vibrant and culturally diverse audience of loyal art collectors, enthusiasts, and families who value creativity, craftsmanship, and artistic expression.

Beyond the exceptional artwork, Cottonwood offers a dynamic weekend of entertainment and experiences, including live music on two stages, a Friday evening gala for artists and guests, an interactive children’s art area, and much more. Artists are invited to apply for the opportunity to exhibit their work and become part of one of Texas’ most celebrated and longstanding fine art festivals, May 1-2, 2027.

items.name: Annapolis Holiday Market 2026
items.shortDescription:
Showcase your art in Annapolis, Maryland, December 4 to 6 and December 11 to 13, 2026. The Annapolis Holiday Market is open Friday and Saturday and is located next to Annapolis Mall, which gets between 20,000 and 35,000 visitors per day. Average household income for those visiting the Mall area is $180,000.

Join the 5th annual Annapolis Holiday Market with other artisans, crafters, and holiday food makers for a fun and festive holiday market that includes live daily entertainment. It's located in a highly visible location near the intersection of Route 50, West Street, and Jennifer Road in the parking lot of Annapolis Mall, a thriving regional shopping destination that will keep the foot traffic coming. The Crowne Plaza Hotel is located across the street,  and about a dozen hotels are located within a 3-mile radius. 

Annapolis serves as the State capital, home to the US Naval Academy, a regional hospital, and a gateway to the Chesapeake Bay, so there is a steady flow of tourists, employees, and locals in the area. Annapolis is frequently mentioned as a top holiday destination due to its many holiday events, including the Annapolis Holiday Market. 

Annapolis Holiday Market will have a robust marketing outreach and marketing partners, including Annapolis Mall and Visit Annapolis. We will be promoting the event as well. The event attracts thousands of visitors daily. Artists consistently report strong sales and incredible community support. Free parking and admission,

items.name: Naples Art Institute's Art in the Park 2026 (Fall)
items.shortDescription:
Naples Art Institute's Art in the Park is Naples' original outdoor art fair, first held in 1957. Over time, Art in the Park evolved into a seasonal series of events that firmly established itself as a showcase for the talents of local and regional artists, attracting a loyal and well-heeled audience. Its user-friendly format, affordability, and sales potential in Naples' affluent market appeal to young and emerging artists as well as established ones, helping them to build relationships and grow their business. 

For the 2026-2027 season, Naples Art Institute will host three Art in the Park events, all of which are by our building in Cambier Park, in the heart of Naples:
  • Nov 28, 2026 - Art in the Park (Fall): ARTful Gifts - a fair with art and crafts to kick off Naples' holiday shopping season. Make your booth festive and bring works suitable for gifts! - Jewelry is FULL for Fall AIP - Waitlist only
  •  
  • Feb 6, 2027 - Art in the Park (Winter): Invitational
     
  • Apr 10, 2027 - Art in the Park (Spring): Local to Local (with Naples Art Institute Open House)
Art in the Park events are limited to 50 booth spaces, set along park pathways. Our building and existing park facilities provide all the supporting services needed for smooth, easy events.

items.name: McKinney Arts in Bloom Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
Arts in Bloom is produced and sponsored by McKinney Main Street in partnership with the City of McKinney. This event takes place in Downtown McKinney and showcases over 100 juried artists, along with a Local Artist Village. The festivities take place on the tree-lined streets surrounding the newly renovated Courthouse Theater.

A nationally recognized participant in the Main Street Program, Downtown McKinney offers a unique, beautiful setting of restored turn-of-the-century buildings that now feature cafes, offices, bars, boutiques, galleries, and restaurants. 

During the event, downtown streets come alive with fascinating sights and sounds as fine artists, dancers, performance artists, musicians, Texas wineries, and food vendors take part in the three-day celebration. There’s also a hands-on interactive area for children, the KidsCreate Station, where young Picassos can learn about art processes and create their own masterpieces.

Our 2027 dates, April 9-11, fall nicely between other well-known Texas art festivals.

To get an idea of Arts in Bloom and our downtown setting, please preview this short, 2-minute video highlighting our festival!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qVRfpe-kkxw&feature=youtu.be

(All information and fees in this application may change without prior notice.)

items.name: Rose Squared Fine Craft Spring Rittenhouse Square 2027
items.shortDescription:
We invite you to apply to the Rose Squared Fine Craft Show Spring Rittenhouse Square, May 7-9, 2027.  Rose Squared Art Shows has partnered with the Friends of Rittenhouse and Parks and Recreation to bring you this highly coveted outdoor event, in Center City Philadelphia. This event draws a robust crowd of wealthy patrons from within the city, the surrounding suburbs, NJ and DE. 

NOTE THAT THIS SHOW IS STRICTLY FINE CRAFT - NO APOTHECARY, ARTISANAL FOOD, DRAWING, PAINTING, WATERCOLOR, OR MARBLE SCULPTURE.  
  • Thursday timed load in and set-up and Sunday tear-down
  • Limited to 160 booths
  • Gorgeous, picturesque park maintained by Friends of Rittenhouse
  • Professional Staff onsite during entire show
  • 24-hour security provided by Philadelphia off duty police
  • Extensive Marketing and PR
  • Active promotion on the Rose Square website, including accompanying artwork images, email contact, and links to business website
  • Tent Rental Company with professional artist tents available (including some artist display items)
This show does not allow pop-up tents of any design or manufacturer. We offer a pass through tent rental service with The Tent Guys.

items.name: Naples Artcrafters January 2027 Show (Fine Artist and Fine Artcrafters)
items.shortDescription:
We are one of the oldest arts organizations supporting Fine Arts and Crafts and local Artists in the Naples Florida area over 65+ years of experience!
Intrested in donating to Naples Art Crafters? Click here
If artist is accepted, upon receiving acceptance they will be required to purchase the booth fee at the Naples Artcrafters store.

Naples Artcrafters is a show that specializes in fine art. In bussiness for over 65 years, our show season runs from November through April. Our monthly shows are free to the public and are held on Saturdays in Cambier Park in downtown Naples.

Show hours are 10 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. 

Cambier Park is one block south of Fifth Avenue in downtown Naples and is in walking distance to many fine restaurants, boutiques, and galleries. Parking for the Cambier Park shows is free and available in the public parking garage adjacent to the park in downtown Naples.

items.name: Art on Main Clayton - GA 2027
items.shortDescription:
Join us for 2027 Art on Main – Clayton, Ga Saturday May 1 & Sunday May 2

Eighty plus (80+) artists from across the Southeast will showcase their work on North Main Street in the Heart of Downtown, Clayton (Rabun County) GA. nestled in the scenic North Georgia Mountains. Your participation in Art on Main – Clayton, Ga is an opportunity to show your work to thousands of visitors throughout the festival weekend.

Here's why you should join us in 2027:
  • A two-day, admission free, event that draws artists and visitors from neighboring counties, states, and beyond
  • Produced by the North Georgia Arts Guild, Inc (est. 1994) - who is committed to giving you the best show experience possible 
  • An experienced staff, dedicated steering committee, and engaged volunteers ready to assist you with your needs
  • Welcoming supportive community of art enthusiasts
  • Established and emerging artists;  traditional, whimsical, fine and folk art, and fine crafts  
  • Cash awards totaling $1500 for Best in Show and Producers’ Award
  • Artist Amenities (see general information)

items.name: Venice-Nokomis Rotary Art Festival 2027 - 35th Annual
items.shortDescription: For over 35 Years the Venice-Nokomis Rotary Club has hosted the most artist friendly Art Festival in South Florida.  Our artists consistently give us great reviews for the support we provide, easy in-load and out-load, enthusiastic crowds, and overnight security.  We attract thousands of attendees with our array of artists, antique/classic automobiles, live music, family fun, tasty food, and drink.  Venice is directly on the Gulf of Mexico and has some of the best beaches in Florida which attract thousands of northerners every winter.  The Rotary Art Festival has grown in popularity over the past years, and we expect to continue to attract more artists and larger attendance in 2027.

items.name: Old Town Art Show 2027
items.shortDescription:
REAL ART | REAL ARTISTS

The 17th Annual Old Town Art  Show will be held on Palm Sunday weekend, March 20 + 21, 2027, in the Nation's Oldest City, Saint Augustine, Florida.

You are invited to apply to this carefully juried, reasonably priced, two-day event open to all artists and fine craftsmen. Produced by artists for artists; we understand your needs!

Saint Augustine, the "Nation's Oldest City", is a coastal community located in the Northeast corner of Florida. The city has received numerous accolades including USA Today - "Best Historic Small Town", Southern Living Magazine - #3 Best Small Town in the South, and #1 Best Food Town in the South. The metro population, according to the US Census, is over 200,000.

items.name: Marion Arts Festival 2027
items.shortDescription:
Join the 35th Annual Marion Arts Festival!

Greetings from the heart of East Central Iowa! The Marion Arts Festival is a one-day event that brings together 50 of the nation's most respected artists to an audience of over 10,000 enthusiastic art lovers.

Known for its intimate and purposeful atmosphere, the festival aims to create a thriving environment for both artists and art enthusiasts. In addition to the juried art fair, the event features live music, activities for all ages, food vendors, and a popular half-marathon and 5K race. It's a key cultural event for the community and a highlight of the year for art lovers in Eastern Iowa.

Why artists love our show:

  • Convenient setup: Our newly renovated festival street allows you to load directly into your booth. 
  • You are our guest: Join us for the artist party on Friday with drinks & heavy appetizers. On festival day receive complimentary breakfast, lunch, coffee and snack bags. Hotel block available for artists and you will be home by Sunday!
  • A thriving community: We're the only event of our kind in Eastern Iowa and a cherished annual tradition for our community. Our mission is to be an event where you can truly thrive.
  • A premier event: We're consistently named among Art Fair SourceBook's Top 50 Events.

"Our show is one-day, intimate, and purposeful, with the mission to be an event through which you can thrive."

Visit our gallery of 2026 exhibitors HERE! and see the incredible talent we had last year.

items.name: Christmas on the River - Savannah River Street Art Market 2026 (December 4-5-6) Rousakis Plaza
items.shortDescription:
Join us for the  Savannah Riverside Market, a three-day outdoor art and fine craft market set along Savannah's world-famous riverfront during the busy fall holiday shopping season weekend.

Nestled beside the scenic Savannah River, this event will bring together a carefully curated collection of artists, makers, and specialty vendors in one of the Southeast's most visited destinations. Surrounded by historic architecture, waterfront views, restaurants, hotels, and shops, exhibitors will have the opportunity to engage with both Savannah residents and the thousands of visitors who flock to the city each holiday weekend.

The Savannah Riverfront is one of the city's premier attractions, drawing travelers from across the country who come to experience Savannah's unique blend of history, culture, hospitality, and Southern charm. The Savannah Riverside Market is designed to create an enjoyable shopping experience while providing artists with strong exposure in a highly walkable, destination-oriented setting.

Be among the first exhibitors to help establish what promises to become a new Labor Day weekend tradition on Savannah's historic waterfront. We look forward to welcoming you to the inaugural Savannah Riverside Market.

Festival Hours: Friday 12/04 10 AM - 6 PM, Saturday 12/05 10AM - 6 PM, Sunday 12/06 10AM - 4PM (allowed to stay late)

items.name: LAYERED LIVES | There's Always Something Underneath
items.shortDescription:
ShadowBoxX Gallery and the Chicago Women's Caucus for Art (CWCA) present LAYERED LIVES, an international juried exhibition exploring women's lived experiences and the many selves we become over a lifetime.

What do we reveal? What do we conceal? And what remains beneath the surface?

Artists of all identities are welcome. Women, including transgender women, as well as non-binary and LGBTQ+ artists, are especially encouraged to apply. Current CWCA Chicago chapter members receive preferential consideration.

Opening February 20, 2027, during Waukegan's monthly ArtWauk celebration.

items.name: Life in the Forest
items.shortDescription:
A forest can be an amazing, sometimes mystical place. Light filtering through the canopy of
trees reveal the many plants and animals that call the forest home. It can also open your
imagination to rarer, mythical forest dwellers. Fantastical creatures, fairies, elves, and the
occasional unicorn might be seen out of the corner of your eye. This exhibit will show the wonders, both real and imaginary, of a walk in the forest.
Work in all 2D and 3D media will be considered by the jury.

Artists are invited to submit original artwork for the Life in the Forest exhibit at the Kavanagh Gallery of Fine Line Creative Arts Center, St. Charles, Illinois.

The Fine Line Creative Arts Center is located in the Fox River Valley, approximately one hour west of Chicago, Illinois.   The show will run from February 18 to April 2, 2027, and is open to artists 18 and older who reside in the United States.

items.name: The Container Show
items.shortDescription:
Artists are invited to submit original artwork for The Container Show at the Kavanagh Gallery, Fine Line Creative Arts Center in St. Charles, Illinois. A container is defined as a receptacle for holding liquid or solid goods. It may be closed with a lid, clasp, or similar, or open. Examples include bags, boxes, baskets, vases and bowls.  The show is open to 3-D work in any medium. No paintings, photographs, or other 2-D work will be accepted.

The Container Show is a regional show open to artists 18 years or older who reside in one of the following states:  Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, North Dakota, Ohio, South Dakota, and Wisconsin.  ​

The Fine Line Creative Arts Center is located in the Fox River Valley, approximately one hour west of Chicago, Illinois.   

The show will run from April 8 – May 21, 2027

items.name: Art Under the Elms 2027
items.shortDescription:
The 43rd annual Art Under the Elms is a three-day arts festival held on the scenic Lewis-Clark State College campus in Lewiston, Idaho. This free community event features over 100 artisan vendors, youth and emerging artist exhibits, live performances, and food vendors. Visitors can enjoy hands-on workshops led by artists, creative activities in the Children’s Art Tent, and interactive youth art experiences.

Art Under the Elms attracts more than 10,000 visitors each year and supports the Center for Arts & History’s mission to connect campus and community through the arts, culture, and humanities. All proceeds benefit the Center’s exhibitions, programs, and arts education initiatives.

items.name: Best of the Northwest Spring Show 2027
items.shortDescription:
APRIL 17 & 18, 2027

You are invited to apply for the 38th Annual Best of the Northwest Spring Show, Seattle’s Premier Art & Fine Craft Show, and this year we’re giving it a fresh look.

This long-running event is highly reviewed by both artists and patrons. It’s held in person at the historic Hangar 30 in Warren G. Magnuson Park in Seattle.

A FRESH LOOK FOR SPRING

The Best of the Northwest Spring Show is getting a refresh, and we think you’ll like what’s sprouting.

We’re not ready to share everything yet, but here’s a teaser:

  • Something new, live, and a tad competitive: Think art showdown, an audience, and a ticking clock.
  • Seminars and workshops for the public: More reasons for new visitors to walk through the door all weekend.
  • Garden art partners: New growth for the show, with partners who bring the outdoors in.
  • More draws for the crowd: Limited edition merchandise and exciting new prize drawings.
  • More to come...

ARTIST AMENITIES:

  • Easy ground-floor load-in
  • Free booth sitting
  • Pagliacci pizza and salad dinner for artists on load-in night
  • Artist lounge with snacks and water
  • Juror’s and People’s Choice prizes awarded
  • Free parking
  • 10 free passes for your best customers
  • Postcards mailed to you for your show promotion
  • A variety of booth sizes to best suit your display
  • Free electricity with your booth purchase
  • Group hotel rates available
  • Full media plan to advertise the event
  • Artist spotlight for artists interested in live demoing their work

items.name: 2027 Weir Farm Artist-In-Residence Program
items.shortDescription: The Artist-in-Residence (AIR) Program at Weir Farm National Historical Park (WEFA) selects artists to spend up to one month living and working at the park. Visual artists apply for residencies in all media and artistic points of view from traditional to experimental.

items.name: MOP: Black Tie
items.shortDescription:
"MOP Black Tie" 

 Valkarie Gallery is elated for their MOP  (month of photography) exhibition, Black Tie; it is a juried photography event celebrating the timeless sophistication, clean lines, and deep emotional resonance of classic monochrome imagery. This call for entry invites photographers to submit traditional, sleek, and elegant black-and-white photography that embraces the power of light, shadow, and form.

items.name: SAGE Community Arts 17th Annual National Juried Show
items.shortDescription:
SAGE Community Arts | Sheridan, Wyoming

Exhibition Dates: January 19 – March 6, 2027

SAGE Community Arts invites artists from across the United States to submit their work for our 17th Annual National Juried Art Exhibition, held in Sheridan, Wyoming.

This year's exhibition embraces an open theme, inviting artists to submit work that best represents their artistic vision, creativity, and individual voice.

Juror Seth Tummins encourages artists to submit the work they feel best about sharing, without the limitations of a predetermined theme. The exhibition will take shape through the works selected, allowing unexpected connections, conversations, and themes to emerge.

With $3,150 in cash awards, this exhibition celebrates artistic excellence and the diverse perspectives of artists working across a wide range of mediums.

KEY DATES:

Dec 4, 2026 | Call CLOSES!
Dec 11, 2026  | Artists will be notified via email
January 19, 2027 | Juried Show opens 
Jan 28, 2027 | Awards Reception, 5:30 pm - 7:30 pm...

items.name: 52nd Annual Juried University of Wyoming Student Exhibition
items.shortDescription:
A highlight of the University of Wyoming Art Museum’s exhibition program, the 52nd Annual Juried University of Wyoming Student Exhibition presents artwork from selected University of Wyoming students. Open to any student currently enrolled at UW, including in-state students in the Distance Learning Program, the 2027 exhibition is juried by Fonda Portales, Director of University Art at Boise State University. This year’s exhibition will be organized around work exploring “traces.” 

The student exhibition provides a professional development opportunity for students to present their work in a museum setting. Scholarship and purchase awards will be announced during the opening reception on Thursday, February 18, 2027.

The exhibition will be on view at the University of Wyoming Art Museum from February 18 through May 15, 2027.

items.name: Contemporary Indigeneity 2027
items.shortDescription: For the sixth iteration of Contemporary Indigeneity, the Great Plains Art Museum seeks Native American artists addressing any issues and themes relevant to the contemporary Indigenous experience on the Great Plains. A panel of Native American art professionals will review the submitted work and make selections based on the artwork’s aesthetic merit and contribution to the field of contemporary art.

items.name: Blue Sky 2027 Pacific Northwest Drawers
items.shortDescription: Blue Sky is celebrating twenty years of the Pacific Northwest Drawers (PNW Drawers) program! Established in 2007, the PNW Drawers program features a juried public archive of original prints by contemporary photographers from the Pacific Northwest region. The program features work by up to 60 artists based in Alaska, British Columbia, Washington, Oregon, Idaho, and Montana. Selected work can be viewed in the flat files for a full year at the gallery, or digitally on the Blue Sky website. The online exhibition will remain a part of the Blue Sky digital archive indefinitely. We are pleased to open the 2027 call, juried by Shana Lopes, the Baker Street Foundation Associate Curator of Photography at the San Francisco Museum of Modern Art (SFMOMA).

items.name: A Wild Life: The Art of Animals
items.shortDescription: Artlink is now accepting submissions for A Wild Life, a national juried call for artwork inspired by animals. From direct depictions celebrating the beauty, fierceness, or fragility of animal-kind, to conceptual works exploring human impact, endangerment, and loss of habitat.. all animal-inspired work is welcome, in any medium! Including but not limited to: painting, photography, video, sculpture, ceramics, glass, jewelry, fiber, drawing, and installation.

items.name: Squared: a 12"x12" Exhibition
items.shortDescription: The Deines Cultural Center invites artists of all backgrounds, mediums, and skill levels to submit work for our upcoming 12x12 Exhibition. This dynamic show challenges artists to express their unique vision within a strict, uniform size.

items.name: Repurpose: The Art of Upcycling
items.shortDescription: Repurpose is a national juried exhibition open to any artwork which includes elements of upcycling in its creation. Whether that be through use of found objects, reuse of materials, or repurposing of old artworks. Upcycling is the art of taking discarded materials and elevating them into a renewed existence of higher quality, greater value, or increased utility. Any artist 18+ residing in the United States is eligible.

items.name: Water Quality Services Division Building Project
items.shortDescription: The City of Fort Collins, Colorado, Art in Public Places Program (APP) is seeking submissions to select an artist/artist team to develop art concepts for the Water Quality Services Division Building Project. The artists/teams will work with the project team to develop concepts for art at the site. Artists/teams will be selected based on their qualifications/application materials. The art project is estimated at $295,000.

items.name: New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival presented by Shell - Congo Square African Marketplace 2027
items.shortDescription:
The New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival presented by Shell is a joyous and spirited celebration showcasing the authentic music and heritage of Louisiana and New Orleans. It began in 1970 when 350 musicians entertained a crowd half that number in New Orleans' Congo Square. The Festival is one of the most prestigious and well-attended in the nation, attracting hundreds of thousands of people annually.

The Festival is owned by The New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival and Foundation, Inc., a Louisiana non-profit corporation organized to preserve and promote the music, arts, culture and heritage indigenous to Louisiana and the New Orleans area. A two-weekend event featuring fourteen stages of music, plus art and traditional food, this outdoor daytime celebration is held on the park-like infield and in the grandstand area of the historic Fair Grounds Race Course. The Crafts Fairs present works by Louisiana, national and international artisans participating in three tented areas - Contemporary Crafts, Louisiana Marketplace, and Congo Square African Marketplace.

The Congo Square African Marketplace is named in honor of the historic New Orleans landmark and site of the very first Jazz Fest.  The highly competitive juried area will accept approximately fifty-two Artists and Vendors each weekend.  Artists make handcrafted contributions to the art of the Diaspora, while Vendors present traditional handcrafted art from the African continent.

items.name: Mark Arts National Oil Painting Exhibition
items.shortDescription:
Mark Arts, in Wichita, Kansas invites artists to submit works for the Mark Arts National Oil Painting exhibition opening Friday, January 8, 2027.  Artists may submit up to four original two-dimensional, representational works of art in oil media. (See Media Limitations for more information.)  Artwork must be for sale, created in the last two years, and not previously exhibited in Wichita, Kansas.

Acclaimed painter Daniel Keys will serve as the juror for the exhibition.  Mark Arts is proud to offer $3,000 in cash awards to attract leading artists from across the country, including $1,500 for first place. 

Please read the full prospectus for full rules and details.

items.name: Krampusnacht IX
items.shortDescription:
We're seeking artists to submit work for our 9th annual Krampusnacht, a group exhibition celebrating the folklore, mystery, and mischievous spirit of Krampus. From traditional Alpine legends to contemporary interpretations, we invite artists to explore the eerie, playful, macabre, and beautifully bizarre aspects of this iconic winter figure.

Emerging and established artists are encouraged to apply.

Memento Mori Gallery & Tattoo is a lowbrow contemporary art gallery & private tattoo studio located in the 40West Arts District in Lakewood, Colorado, just 15 minutes from downtown Denver. We are in the same shopping center as Casa Bonita.

items.name: 46th Annual Western Spirit Juried Art Show and Sale
items.shortDescription:
Full Prospectus Click HERE


The Cheyenne Frontier Days Old West Museum invites you to enter the 46th Annual Western Spirit Juried Art Show & Sale. Over 150 western artworks will be selected in the premier juried art show in the Rocky Mountain region for emerging and established artists. The event is held in the historic Carriage Hall at the CFD Old West Museum March 6th - April 18th, 2027. 

Categories: Acrylic, Drawing, Mixed-Media (including digital art), Oil, Pastel, Photography, Print-making, Sculpture and Watercolor and a special separate category for student artwork.

*We do not accept installation art or AI Generated Art*

Please note, on 3-D pieces we can only accept one image/view unless a photo editor has been used to combine multiple views into one jpg file.

items.name: Fine Art Quilts 2027
items.shortDescription:
We invite artists working in the medium of quilt making to submit work for the inaugural Fine Arts Quilts exhibition celebrating the artistic and expressive potential of quilts. This juried show seeks quilts that demonstrate originality, strong design and the visual impact of fine art–beauty for its own sake. 

Whether abstract or representational, minimalist or intricate, entries should showcase quilting as a serious art form. Traditional techniques are welcome if presented in innovative ways. All entries must be original compositions and may include mixed media, surface design, or unconventional materials. 

Best of Show may be presented the opportunity to have  a future solo show at the Loewen Studio & Gallery. 

The People's Choice award is $500. This will be voted on by in person gallery visitors. One vote per visitor.

Join us in honoring and promoting the quilt as a canvas for artistic expression.

items.name: 12 x 12 Museum Fundraiser
items.shortDescription: Display your work in the museum and support the arts in Southern Oregon during this fundraising exhibit. The Grants Pass Museum of Art is raising funds that provide free admission for museum visitors, affordable art classes, great exhibitions, and amazing programs for kids.

items.name: Exploring Darkness and Shadows
items.shortDescription:
The words 'Darkness' and 'Shadow' often connote psychological fear, chaos, the unknown and death. However the the night sky, the fertile soil and the maternal womb are all dark and healthy places necessary for life.

In Jun'ichirō Tanizaki's book, "In Praise of Shadows" he states that many eastern cultures prefer jade to emeralds because those cultures prefer a "pensive luster to a shallow brilliance". He also goes on to say that in Japan the tarnished aging of silver is valued over the high gleam of polished silver, and that the aged grain of old wood is appreciated over the light tone of new wood.

For our next L7 Gallery online show we invite international artists who love to explore the various meanings of both darkness and shadow in their art work.  

1st Place: Award of $300. Two additional artists receive honorable mentions.

Accepting: Painting, Drawing, Watercolor, Photography, Sculpture, Digital Art, Printmaking, and Fabric Art

items.name: Fragments: a Juried Exhibition of Collage
items.shortDescription:
Spark Gallery invites artists to submit works that use collage as a primary element for a juried group exhibition, entitled “Fragments”. Artwork submitted must be no wider than 12 inches and must be unframed and lightweight. Work will be installed using magnets or clips (such as clothespins or binder clips).

The exhibition will be juried by Daisy Fodness-McGowan, Executive & Artistic Director of RiNo Art District.

Cash prizes will be awarded.

Spark Gallery is an artist-run, non-profit gallery located in the Golden Triangle museum district of downtown Denver.

items.name: 2027 Members' Juried Exhibition
items.shortDescription: Tubac Center of the Arts annual “Members’ Juried Exhibit” is a juried exhibition open to all members of the Tubac Center of the Arts and all media is accepted.

items.name: Big Sky
items.shortDescription:
A NATIONAL CALL FOR ART IN ALL MEDIA

Open to all artists, aged 18 or older, residing in the US

Entry Deadline: November 17, 2026

Entry Fee: $25.00

EXHIBITION DATES: January 8-February 8, 2027 

Every sky can be big. Webster Arts invites submissions for our opening show of 2027, Big Sky - artists may submit 2D and 3D artwork that delves into the sights that stir our souls. From vast, natural geographies to constructed architectural skylines, whether mapping the terrains of our souls or the layouts of our living rooms, you are invited to explore the expanses of your world.

Artists are encouraged to submit original, 2D & 3D work in any medium completed within the last three (3) years. No video.

items.name: ARTcetera 2027
items.shortDescription: ARTcetera 2027 is the Sioux City Art Center’s art auction fundraiser. Every three years we throw a big party to celebrate the art and creativity of our region.

items.name: GO GREEN
items.shortDescription:
Art Fluent invites artists worldwide to submit artwork to our online exhibit, GO GREEN

THEME
Green sits at the psychological midpoint of the color spectrum, and the eye processes it with the least strain of any hue. It's tied to safety, stability, and growth, though it can just as easily tip into envy or unease. That range makes it one of the more emotionally loaded colors artists can work with. Show us your version of GO GREEN.


CALENDAR
JPEGs due by Friday, November 20, 2026, at midnight MST.
Notification of acceptance and online gallery opening by Friday, December 18, 2026.

AWARDS
All accepted pieces will be displayed in our online gallery at www.art-fluent.com
Best of Show: $750
Two Director’s Choice awards: $250 each

items.name: In Practice: Annual Juried Exhibition
items.shortDescription:
For over a decade, Foothills Art Center (FAC) has hosted its annual Members’ Exhibition, welcoming new artists onto our walls while celebrating the extraordinary talent of our longtime creative community.

This year, we continue that tradition under a new name: In Practice.

items.name: Lakewood Ranch Holiday of the Arts December 2026 (Paragon Festivals)
items.shortDescription:
Join us for the 4th annual Lakewood Ranch Holiday of the Arts, taking place December 5–6, 2026 on charming Main Street in downtown Lakewood Ranch, FL. Setup is Saturday from 5:00–9:00 am. Show hours are Saturday and Sunday, 10:00 am–5:00 pm. Admission is free and open to the public.

Lakewood Ranch is one of the most desirable communities in Florida, with a well-educated population and an average household income exceeding $100,000. In addition, Lakewood Ranch is recognized as the largest certified green community in the United States which makes it a perfect setting for a fine art event that attracts a sophisticated and engaged audience.

                                              Paragon Festivals: Original - Quality - Boutique!

items.name: Wigwam Holiday Festival of Arts 2026
items.shortDescription:
The Wigwam Holiday Festival of Arts 
Patrons enjoy a festive holiday shopping experience. The Show sets up on the manicured front lawn along the grand entrance to the iconic Wigwam Resort. Patrons enjoy strolling the historic grounds of the cherished Arizona landmark, while perusing a curated selection of fine arts and crafts from 125+ artists and craftsmen. Patio dining, live musical performances, wine and rereshing cocktails elevate and enhance the festival experience. 

Free admission & free parking
